questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

45 – 49 + 26 × 70 ÷ 35 = 42
questions.solution:
According to the BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

**Option 1 :** × and –

**Given:**

45 – 49 + 26 × 70 ÷ 35 = 42

After interchange the signs;

45 × 49 + 26 - 70 ÷ 35 = 42

By BODMAS rule

45 × 49 + 26 - 2 = 42

2205 + 26 - 2 = 42

2231 - 2 = 42

2229 = 42** (LHS ≠ RHS)**

**Option 2 : **÷ and ×

Given: 

45 – 49 + 26 × 70 ÷ 35 = 42

After interchange the signs;

45 – 49 + 26 ÷ 70 × 35 = 42

By BODMAS rule

45 – 49 + 0.37 × 35 = 42

45 – 49 + 13 = 42

58 – 49 = 42

9 = 42** (LHS ≠ RHS)**

**Option 3: **+ and ×

Given:

45 – 49 + 26 × 70 ÷ 35 = 42

After interchange the signs;

45 – 49 × 26 + 70 ÷ 35 = 42

By BODMAS rule

45 – 49 × 26 + 2 = 42

45 – 1274 + 2 = 42

47 – 1274 = 42

– 1227 = 42 **(LHS ≠ RHS)**

**Option 4: **+ and –

**Given:**

**45 – 49 + 26 × 70 ÷ 35 = 42**

**After interchange the signs;**

**45 + 49 - 26 × 70 ÷ 35 = 42**

**By BODMAS rule**

**45 + 49 - 26 × 2 = 42**

**45 + 49 - 52 = 42**

**94 - 52 = 42**

**42 = 42 (LHS = RHS)**

Hence, the answer is **“****+ and –****”.**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some balls are spoons.

All stones are balls.

No ball is a pebble.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some balls are stones.

II. No spoon is a stone.

III. No stone is a pebble.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Both conclusions I and III follow
Both conclusions II and III follow.

questions.solution:
Statements:

Some balls are spoons.

All stones are balls.

No ball is a pebble.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23adfc3495c0590241d54490af48cf670cc46a7e53efa3556351822c785f4c45.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some balls are stones → True (Because all stones are balls so some balls are also stones)

II. No spoon is a stone → False (It is possible but not definite)

III. No stone is a pebble → True (Because all stones are balls and no ball is pebble so definitely no stone is a pebble)

Hence, “**Both conclusions I and III follow**” is the correct answer.
